ask: A driver exposing read/write of arbitrary process memory over IOCTL. One line: the IOCTL surface.
text: Two IOCTL codes — `IOCTL_READ_PROCESS_MEMORY` and `IOCTL_WRITE_PROCESS_MEMORY` — each dispatched with a single input struct carrying `{ ULONG64 pid, ULONG64 address, ULONG64 buffer, SIZE_T size }`, copied in from userland via `IoStackLocation->Parameters.DeviceIoControl`.
